translations.web: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
translations.bsb: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
translations.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things
